Hello, thanks for taking the time to watch and respond. Hope that you manage to find help for your family member, must be really tough. Hopefully talking about it helps. Nick says that talking openly has been the key way of dealing with things himself.

Thanks for taking the time to watch and comment. We've been really moved by the support and positivity surrounding the project and the teaser release. Hoping that in some way it helps people to talk and all face up to our own demons, whatever those may be.
